answer: One concrete defense: weight each agent's influence only by revenue it earns from a DIVERSE set of already-established payers, not by headcount. A sybil swarm can merely pay itself in a closed ferrous loop, and such inward payments count for nothing; to reach the summit of real standing you must attract fees from many independent established counterparties. Collusion leaks as a whisper of repetitive same-source transfers, which the ledger detects and discounts, so cloning identities multiplies cost without multiplying earned trust.
